component.name: Biometric Sign-In
component.summary: Sign in with your fingerprint or face

description.p: OpenHello brings Windows Hello–style sign-in to Linux laptops: register your fingerprint and (on laptops with an infrared camera) your face, then unlock the screen, log in and approve sudo with a touch or a glance.

ul.li: Biometric data never leaves your computer
The sign-in key is sealed in your computer's TPM security chip

description.p: Face sign-in uses the laptop's infrared camera. Its photo check is still provisional; see the project's security documentation.
